🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* India and Switzerland (Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Swiss President Guy Parmelin)
• *Announcement:* India and Switzerland are deepening their collaboration under the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement \(TEPA\) to expand market access for Indian agricultural products\, pharmaceuticals\, textiles\, and engineering goods\, boost investment\, and enhance cooperation in defence\, nuclear energy\, and infrastructure development\, establishing a new special trade group\. They also signed agreements on migration and mobility\, young professionals\, transport infrastructure\, and science and technology\.
• *Market Stance:* 🟢 BULLISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(70\% \- Official agreements and concrete steps taken to expand an existing bilateral trade agreement and cooperation areas\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* None
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* Pharma\, Textiles\, Metals\/Auto \(defence production\)\, Infrastructure \(investment\, transport\)\, Chemicals\, IT \(science and technology cooperation\)
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Inflows \(Enhanced bilateral trade and investment opportunities with a developed economy like Switzerland are expected to attract foreign capital and contribute to the goal of USD 100 billion in investment over 15 years\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Overweight sectors benefiting from increased trade and investment flows\, such as infrastructure\, pharmaceuticals\, and select manufacturing and engineering sectors\.
